allowed_claims: The source repository contains versioned contracts, implementation scaffolds, assertion-level traceability and deterministic static checks.
The roadmap contains 200 acceptance assertions, of which 115 have individual symbol/test/evidence mappings; unmapped or partial assertions remain visibly below source implemented.
Four MVP connector vertical slices and rights-clear response baselines are present in source, but compilation and authorised live execution are not proven.
Native strategy text, spans and translation-loss diagnostics are preserved for seven database dialect families; semantic parsing and equivalence remain deliberately partial.
A deterministic review-bundle pack/verify self-test and a deterministic noncanonical review-state reducer pass locally.
All workspace crates are non-publishable by default; three future public-package candidates are identified but none is publication-ready.
CiteWeft integration is prepared behind an optional one-way adapter.
A four-level GitHub issue hierarchy and a declarative Project v2 control plane are source-verified and dry-run-first.
A separate cross-repository portfolio Project manifest, ecosystem lock and companion change packets are prepared but not remotely applied.
Registry, release, pilot and maturity packets are prepared but not submitted, executed or accepted.
Every registered static gate has an explicit no-network/no-write capability profile, assertion coverage and source-level evidence ceiling.
Provider policy surfaces and conservative local defaults are recorded for all five MVP provider baselines, but none is legally approved or live-proven.
A deterministic receipt-redaction profile passes adversarial local cases; it is a minimisation control rather than de-identification proof.
Known multi-version schema families have explicit non-destructive migration, backup and rollback plans; migration execution remains unproven.
A network-free reference recovery rehearsal passes atomic-replace, idempotent restore and tamper-rejection cases; production recoverability is not claimed.
A deterministic evidence-debt register exposes remaining compiler, provider, methodological, migration and external-review blockers.

language_rules: Use prepared_not_submitted rather than submitted for registry packets.
Use source-verified rather than implemented-and-tested when Cargo evidence is absent.
Describe PRISMA-S as reporting guidance, not a conduct certification.
Describe extraction output as evidence, not canonical bibliographic truth.
Describe a consumer-contract suite as prepared until both producer and consumer receipts exist.
Describe Project and issue state as a coordination projection, never as implementation evidence.
Use prepared_not_executed for release rehearsals and pilots until receipts exist.
Use authenticated-remote-MCP design or source implementation, not hosted service, until deployment evidence exists.
Use backup policy prepared, not recoverable, until a restore drill passes.
Use scaffolded or partially implemented when one or more acceptance assertions lack complete symbol-and-test mappings.
Describe provider response baselines as drift controls, not live-provider proof.
Describe review bundles as integrity-preserving portable artefacts, not methodological certification.
Describe review-state snapshots as disposable derived projections, never canonical decision stores.
Describe public packages as candidates until release/public-packages.json explicitly promotes them with evidence.
Name canonical upstreams separately from local forks and do not infer redistribution rights from fork ownership.
Describe static gates using their catalogued evidence ceiling; never promote a source gate into compiler, live, legal, methodological or operational evidence.
Describe provider policy as source-identified and conservatively configured until review_evidence is present.
Describe redaction as receipt minimisation, not de-identification or proof of absence.
Describe schema migrations as planned until representative compiled migrations and rollback tests execute.
Describe the local recovery self-test as a reference rehearsal, not production recoverability.
Treat evidence-debt counts as a gap register, never a quality or completion score.
